messages.subject: Release of R 3.1.0 causing issues
parts:
Hi All,

For those of you who are thinking of using mirt 1.2.1 with the latest version of R, version 3.1.0, I would recommend holding off. R's latest release appears to treat some objects differently at the c-level (namely, Lists), which I am currently investigating and likely will file a bug report for. A temporary patch has been pushed to the dev version, which appears to be safe to use but will be slightly slower for tests with a larger number of items. Cheers.

Phil
